# 或直接恢复 postgresql.auto.conf 为下方内容
--- 改动前的 postgresql.auto.conf ---
# Do not edit this file manually!
# It will be overwritten by the ALTER SYSTEM command.
--- 改动前生效值 ---

log_lock_waits = off

maintenance_work_mem = 65536 kB
